title: SQL Basics
description: 20 foundational SQL Server interview problems covering SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, HAVING, and basic JOINs.
longDescription: This module covers the fundamental SQL operations every candidate is expected to know. Problems include SELECT basics, WHERE filtering, ORDER BY sorting, GROUP BY aggregation, HAVING, and basic JOINs (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL).
whatYouLearn: Write basic SELECT statements with WHERE filtering
Sort results with ORDER BY and paginate with OFFSET/FETCH
Aggregate data using GROUP BY and HAVING
Combine tables with INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL JOINs
